questions.prompt: If we _____ more trees, the air will be cleaner.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。因此填 plant。
questions.evidence: If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner.

questions.prompt: If you take away parking spaces, some customers _____ to other streets.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句表示将来结果，用 will + 动词原形。因此选 will go。
questions.evidence: If you take away parking spaces for bike lanes, some customers will go to other streets.

questions.prompt: _____ my shop needs parking, I am worried.
questions.explanation: 这里需要表示原因，用 Because 引导原因从句。Therefore 表示结果，不能这样用。
questions.evidence: Because my shop needs parking, I am worried.

questions.prompt: We need 30 trees. _____, we need to raise 6,000 yuan.
questions.explanation: 前句是原因，后句是结果，用 Therefore 表示“因此”。
questions.evidence: Therefore, we need to raise 6,000 yuan.

questions.prompt: We _____ ask the children what they want. (建议)
questions.evidence: We should ask the children what they want.

questions.prompt: We _____ also ask a gardener for advice. (委婉建议)
questions.explanation: 表示“可以”的委婉建议用 could。
questions.evidence: We could also ask a gardener for advice.

questions.prompt: We _____ not forget the noise. (必须)
questions.explanation: 表示“必须”用 must。must not 表示“一定不要”。
questions.evidence: We must not forget the noise.

questions.prompt: If we work together, we _____ a good answer.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句用 will + 动词原形，表示将来结果。
questions.evidence: If we work together, we will find a good answer.

title: A Greener Street: Weighing the Trade-offs · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课学习三个语法点。第一，第一条件句表示“如果……就会……”：If + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。例如：If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner. 第二，because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。because 引导原因从句，therefore 是副词，前面常用逗号。例如：Because my shop needs parking, I am worried. / We need 30 trees. Therefore, we need to raise 6,000 yuan. 第三，情态动词 should, could, must 用于提建议。should 表示“应该”，could 表示“可以（较委婉）”，must 表示“必须”。例如：We should ask the children what they want. / We could also ask a gardener for advice. / We must not forget the noise. 注意：第一条件句中，if 从句不用 will，主句才用 will。

If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner.
